content:
# New Client Onboarding Workflow
# Status: Draft with default assumptions. Values marked "ASSUMPTION" were
# chosen without stakeholder input and should be validated before activation.

workflow:
  name: new_client_onboarding
  description: >
    End-to-end onboarding for a newly signed client, from kickoff through
    handoff to the delivery team.
  version: 0.2.0
  trigger:
    type: manual  # ASSUMPTION: account manager starts onboarding after signature
    started_by: account_manager

  roles:
    account_manager: ASSUMPTION  # owns client relationship and kickoff
    onboarding_manager: ASSUMPTION  # owns execution of steps 2-4
    delivery_lead: ASSUMPTION  # receives handoff

  sla:  # ASSUMPTION: standard mid-market onboarding timeline
    total_duration_days: 14
    per_step_days:
      kickoff: 2
      account_setup: 3
      document_collection: 4
      requirements_gathering: 3
      handoff: 2

  steps:
    - id: kickoff
      name: "Kickoff & Welcome"
      owner: roles.account_manager
      actions:
        - send_welcome_email  # ASSUMPTION: template stored in shared drive
        - schedule_kickoff_meeting
      outputs:
        - kickoff_meeting_scheduled
        - client_contacts_confirmed

    - id: account_setup
      name: "Account & Access Setup"
      owner: roles.onboarding_manager
      actions:
        - create_client_account  # ASSUMPTION: in company's primary platform
        - provision_access_credentials
      outputs:
        - client_account_active
        - credentials_delivered_securely

    - id: document_collection
      name: "Collect Required Documents"
      owner: roles.onboarding_manager
      actions:
        - request_documents
        - verify_documents_received
      checklist:  # ASSUMPTION: generic B2B client document set
        - signed_contract_or_SOW
        - W9_or_tax_form
        - company_profile_or_brand_assets
        - technical_contacts_list
      outputs:
        - documents_verified

    - id: requirements_gathering
      name: "Gather Requirements & Expectations"
      owner: roles.onboarding_manager
      actions:
        - conduct_requirements_session
        - record_summary  # ASSUMPTION: summary saved to shared drive folder
      outputs:
        - requirements_document_approved_by_client

    - id: handoff
      name: "Handoff to Delivery Team"
      owner: roles.onboarding_manager
      actions:
        - notify_delivery_lead  # ASSUMPTION: Slack + email notification
        - transfer_documents_and_requirements
        - confirm_onboarding_complete
      outputs:
        - delivery_team_acknowledged_handoff

  completion:
    criteria:
      - all_steps_completed
      - delivery_lead_acknowledged  # ASSUMPTION: explicit acknowledgment required
    notification:
      recipients:
        - account_manager
        - delivery_lead

  failure_handling:  # ASSUMPTION: escalate stalled steps
    stall_threshold_days: 3
    escalation:
      first: notify_step_owner
      second: notify_account_manager
      after_days: 6
